subject: Fourth Gravestone from Right
text: Pulling aside the fourth gravestone from the right in the rear row of Kakariko Graveyard reveals a pit leading to the Redead grave.

evidence.quote:
Go to the rear row of gravestones, and go to the far right.  Counting from the
right to the left, pull aside the fourth gravestone to reveal another pit.
Drop down the pit.

subject: Redead
text: Attacking the Redead repeatedly reduces its opportunity to attack, and tapping buttons and rotating the joystick frees Link if grabbed.

evidence.quote:
Just go ape crazy on this
Redead, attacking him repeatedly.  The faster you attack him, the less
opportunity he gets to attack you back.  If he does manage to grab hold of you,
tap buttons and rotate the joystick like mad to free yourself.

subject: Sun's Song Chest
text: After permanently defeating the Redead in the grave, playing the Sun's Song spawns a chest containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Once the Redead
is permanently defeated (it will make an extra loud SWIPE noise when it is),
play the Sun's Song to make a chest appear that contains a Piece of Heart.
Open the chest, take the Piece of Heart, and return to Kakariko Graveyard.

subject: Dampe's Heart-Pounding Gravedigging Tour
text: Standing on a dirt patch in Dampe's path causes him to stop, allowing Link to pay him 10 rupees to dig.

evidence.quote:
Dampe takes a circular route around the graveyard, following
the path.  If you stand directly in his path, then he will stop....In order to find the Piece of Heart, stand directly on that dirt patch
so that way Dampe will stop directly in front of it, then speak to Dampe and
pay him 10 rupees to dig up that patch of dirt.

subject: Dampe's Heart-Pounding Gravedigging Tour
text: A Piece of Heart is hidden in one of twelve dirt patches in Kakariko Graveyard and randomly changes places whenever you leave the zone.

evidence.quote:
In one of the
twelve dirt patches dotted around the graveyard, there is hidden a Piece of
Heart....The Piece of Heart randomly changes places every time you
leave the zone, so if you have to leave to restock on Rupees, then just start
over from the beginning.

subject: Dampe's Gravedigging Game
text: Dampe's Gravedigging Game only runs during the first part of the night and cannot be accessed using the Sun's Song.

evidence.quote:
Dampe's Gravedigging Game
only runs for the first part of the night, so if Dampe isn't there then you'll
have to go hang around Hyrule Field until it becomes nighttime again, then
return to the Graveyard.  The Sun's Song won't work (it makes the time either
noon or midnight, and the Gravedigging Tour is open during neither time).

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula is found on the pile of bricks at the Unfinished House in Kakariko Village and should be shot with the Slingshot.

evidence.quote:
There are a ton of Golden Skulltulas to find and kill here in the dead of
night.  The first is at the Unfinished House, on the pile of bricks.  Kill it
with the Slingshot before trying to jump up and grab the token (the sword will
cause you to take damage because of the extreme close range).

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula is located directly beneath a window on the left side of the House of Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The second
Skulltula can be found on the building directly to the west of the Unfinished
Building (the House of Skulltula).  It sits directly beneath a window on the
left side of the building.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula in Kakariko Village can be found by rolling into the tree near the center of town at night.

evidence.quote:
The third Skulltula can be found by rolling into the tree near the center of
Kakariko Village.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is perched on top of the tall observation tower on the upper level of Kakariko Village and can be shot down with the Slingshot.

evidence.quote:
The fourth can be found on top of the tall observation tower
on the upper level of Kakariko Village.  Shoot it with the slingshot before
climbing up the ladder to claim it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the north side of the building closest to the Death Mountain Gate at the northern edge of Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
The last of the Skulltulas can be found in
the northern edge of the village, on the north side of the building closest to
the Death Mountain Gate.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: Speaking to the man on the right inside the House of Skulltula rewards Link with the Adult's Wallet for collecting 10 Gold Skulltula tokens.

evidence.quote:
Enter the building, and turn to the right.  Speak to the man, and he will
reward you with the Adult's Wallet, the award for killing 10 Golden Skulltulas
and claiming their tokens.

subject: Death Mountain Trail Gate Guard
text: Showing Zelda's Letter to the guard by the northern gate allows Link through to Death Mountain Trail.

evidence.quote:
Go to the northern edge of the village and speak with the guard by the gate.
He will refuse to let you through to Death Mountain Trail.  Show him Zelda's
Letter, and he'll let you through, though he'll think it's all a big joke.

subject: Death Mountain Trail Gate Guard
text: The gate guard requests that Link bring him a Keaton Mask from the Hyrule Castle Market to begin the Happy Mask Trading Sequence.

evidence.quote:
He
will request, however, that you return to the Hyrule Castle Market and pick up
a Keaton mask for him.  This is the first step of the Happy Mask Trading
Sequence, the Young Link trading game.

subject: Happy Mask Shop
text: The Happy Mask Shop is located near the Temple of Time to the right of the entrance to the Hyrule Castle Garden.

evidence.quote:
The Happy Mask Shop is now open for business.  It's the small building near the
Temple of Time, to the right of the entrance to the Hyrule Castle Garden.
Enter the building.

subject: Happy Mask Shop
text: Link can borrow the Keaton Mask from the Happy Mask Shop window counter.

evidence.quote:
You will now be able to select masks from the
shop windows as though you were buying them from a regular shop.  Select the
only one available, the Keaton Mask, and return to Kakariko Village.

subject: Death Mountain Trail Gate Guard
text: Speaking to the Death Mountain gate guard while wearing the Keaton Mask prompts him to buy it for 15 rupees.

evidence.quote:
Return to the guard by the gate to Death Mountain, and speak to him while
wearing the Keaton Mask.  He'll pay you 15 rupees for the mask.

subject: Happy Mask Shop
text: After paying the 10-rupee fee for the Keaton Mask at the Happy Mask Shop, Link can borrow the Skull Mask.

evidence.quote: Pay the 10-rupee fee for the Keaton Mask, and then borrow the Skull Mask.

subject: Northern Gate
text: Passing through the northern gate of Kakariko Village leads to Death Mountain Trail.

evidence.quote: Head to the northern gate, and go through to Death Mountain Trail.

subject: Tektite
text: On Death Mountain Trail, hold R to execute Turtle Defense with the Hylian Shield if a Tektite tries to jump on Link.

evidence.quote:
Go forward a bit, and kill the Tektite.  If he tries to jump on you, do the
Turtle Defense with the Hylian Shield (hold R).

subject: Tektite
text: Two Tektites appear around the corner on the path, and another jumps down from above as you follow the trail upward.

evidence.quote:
Go around the corner and
defeat two more Tektites....Keep following the
path up and around, and defeat another Tektite who jumps down from on high.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula can be heard near the corner on Death Mountain Trail, but it cannot be reached until Link obtains Bombs.

evidence.quote:
You can vaguely hear a Gold Skulltula here, but you
won't be able to reach it until you get access to Bombs.

subject: Giant Boulder
text: A Piece of Heart is located high above the giant boulder along the path of Death Mountain Trail.

evidence.quote:
Note the Piece of Heart high above the giant boulder - we'll get to it in a few
minutes.

subject: Wooden Post Intersection
text: At the large wooden post with a red flag, taking the right path past the stone pedestal with a ring of rocks leads into Goron City through an archway.

evidence.quote:
Keep following the path
until you reach a large wooden post with a red flag tied to it.  From here, you
can go left to keep climbing the mountain, or go right to Goron City.  Go
right.  Keep following the path, past the large stone pedestal with the ring of
rocks, and enter the archway carved into the stone to enter Goron City.
